semiconductor_relevance: High — Mikado Technos specializes in advanced plating technologies that are critical for semiconductor device assembly.
summary: Mikado Technos manufactures pressurizing equipment that utilizes solid-phase electrodeposition (SED) technology for plating in semiconductor device assembly. Their vacuum press technology enables bubble-free bonding and joining, making it suitable for various applications in the semiconductor industry.

regional_presence.Japan: Mikado Technos has facilities in Tokyo and Nagano for equipment development and experimentation.
